text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ...In other words, I just need to use that formula from earlier here.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, I see.
That makes sense—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: I don't get it at all!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"...Sigh.
At this rate, you're going to fail tomorrow's pop quiz too, you know?"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: That will be a disaster! I absolutely must avoid supplementary lessons this week!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I made a promise to Urara-kun and Doto
to perform the latest piece of the Opera O Theater for them...!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"Then show a bit more motivation.
If you can't even memorize the formulas, you won't get any points."

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
However, it's hard for me to get interested
in anything that lacks emotion and storytelling—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: I know!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Could you teach me math like it's an opera?!
I'm sure I could memorize it that way!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: What... !?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
You can do it, Hayahide-san!
I, the darling of opera, guarantee it!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Come on, come on, come on!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"...And 5 and 6 also realized
that X was an indispensable existence."

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
And that is factorization.
Did you get all that?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Hmm...
Is the exchange between the characters a bit awkward, perhaps?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Don't overthink it, I think you'd transform if you just unleashed your emotions more!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I wasn't asking for a critique, I wanted to know if you understood...!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah, that's totally set!
Plus, I've just realized a fundamental truth of the world!"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
If I view the world through the lens of opera,
there is nothing I, myself, cannot understand...!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
At this rate, I shall overcome all and become
the one and only, absolute "Supreme Overlord"!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I'm glad to see you've found your motivation.
............*sigh*
